book.name: Maak
book.title: Pwoo ɗeret nKaa Jesu Kristi Ɗe Maak

content: Joon nGucìn Baptisma Ɗak Ar
Ɗesǝ a shee pwoo ɗeret nkaa Jesu Kristi Nguɓam, Làa Naan.
Kaaɗe gyet mo kǝ ten ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal mǝ Aizaya ngusatpwoo Naan sǝ nǝnee,

content.text: <<Naan wur sat nǝ, an nlep ngulep fen
shindǝm a kyeen fwaa, <<mbǝkǝ wur ɗak ar
Mee gwar kǝ pǝreppee shi ɗoo

content: Joon ngucìn baptisma, a wur jì put a naaryil. Wur satpwoo Naan ngurum mo, mbǝkǝ mmo tuwap ɗi, kǝ nwur cìn baptisma ɗi mmo, mbe fwo kǝ shikbish mo-mo.
Nenyil nJudiya mo, kǝ nenyil nJerusalem mo ɗes, mo pwat dǝm pee Joon ɗi, ɗe mo woo shikbish fur mo, ɓe wur cìn baptisma mmo nɗǝǝn gyeen nJodan.
Joon lep a nlǝr ɗe mo ɗak shi shweep raakumi, wur kǝ ɗyiin zaal ɗe mo ɗak shi shim shin ciir mɓwoon fin. Wur kǝ se a ciɓel, kǝ nloor nshìi ɗe mo a yil.
Wur sat ngurum mo nǝnee, <<Mee gwar pǝ jì mɓwoon fen, ɗe, wur ɗes met nghan, kǝ baa ɗeret fen nǝ mak, kǝ nghan ɗoom mbǝkǝ nghan fwen teng kwoopshi wur ɗi kas.
Wen kǝn cìn baptisma nwun a shi am, ɗangɓǝ gwar nǝ wur njì ɓe wur ncìn baptisma nwun a shi Riin Ɗeɓang.>>
Joon Cìn Baptisma nJesu
nƊǝǝn teer mǝnǝ mo, ɓǝ Jesu yool nyil nNazaret mǝ Galili, kǝ wur dǝm pǝ Joon ɗi gyeen nJodan, ɓe Joon cìn baptisma nwur nɗǝǝn gyeen nJodan nǝ.
Kaaɗe Jesu nkaa put nɗǝǝn am nǝ, ɓe abet, wur naa ɗengnaan a wuwang. Ɓe Riin sham kaa mbul sǝ, nǝ sham lang nkaa wur.
Kǝzak, mee ɗoo put nɗǝǝn ɗengnaan ɗe nǝ sat nǝnee, <<Gha a Làa fen ɗe nwal gha, kǝ kat retnyit kǝ gha hakyeng.>>
ngujwaan Kam Jesu
Abet-abet, ɓǝ Riin Naan dǝm kǝ Jesu a naaryil.
Jesu cìn teer laarfeer a yil nǝ, a peeɗi ngujwaan kam wur ɗi. Wur yem ashak kǝ luwaa yil mo. Nenlep Naan mo jì ɓam wur
Jesu Shee Yaa Ɗak nYil nGalili
Aɓwoon ɗe mo kǝ yaa Joon le nɗǝǝn lushoot, ɓǝ Jesu dǝm wul nGalili, wur nkaa satpwoo ɗeret mǝ Naan.
Wur sat ngurum mo nǝnee, <<Pee nǝ kǝ wul, kǝ mulki kǝ Naan nǝ kus zak. Wu tuwap, wu shinzeen mpwoo ɗeret nǝ.>>
Jesu Pet Nen YakPupwap Mo Feer
Kaaɗe Jesu a ar ɗel mpwoo am kuur mǝ Galili, ɓǝ wur naa Simon Pita kǝ ɗyemnǝǝn fin Andru, mon nkaa bwet shang mɓut am, mbe yak pupwap mo.
Ɓe Jesu wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wu jì nɗang nghan, ɓe nghan nle kǝ wu ɗee a nensatpwo kǝ Naan, mbǝkǝ wu dul gurum mo shin jì pee nghan ɗi kaaɗi wuu yak pupwap sǝ.>>
Abet, ɓe mo yool yit shang fur mo, ɓe mo dǝm nɗang wur.
Kaaɗe wur gyes dǝm ɗe a kyeen lee, ɓe wur naa Jemis làa Zeɓeɗi, kǝ ɗyemnǝǝn fin Joon, mo nɗǝǝn tii zak. Mon nkaa ɗak shang fur mo.
Abet, ɓe wur pet mo. Ɓe mo yool yit puun fur Zeɓeɗi nɗǝǝn tii nǝ, ashak kǝ nen ɗe moo cìn ɗak mmo. Ɓe mo dǝm nɗang Jesu.
Mee Gwar ƊewurKǝ Riin Ɗebish
Mo dǝm nɗǝǝn Kaparnahum, ɓe Jesu ɗel nɗǝǝn mee lu Naan parpuus Nookɗi. Ɓe wur yaa kámpwoo Naan ngurum mo.
Kám wur nǝ aapwoo mmo zam, mbǝɗe wu kám a kaa gwar ɗe wu kǝ iiko sǝ, baa a kaa nenkám Wàar Mosis mo sǝ kas.
Mee gwar wu kǝ riin ɗebish, nɗǝǝn lu Naan nǝ, ɓe gwar nǝ ɓwet or.
Wur sat nee, <<Jesu ngwe Nazaret, a me kaat mun kǝ gha ye? A jì mpesi a mbe twe mun aa? Wen man nǝ, gha a gwar ɗeɓang mǝ Naan.>>
Jesu gwak riin ɗebish nǝnee, <<A ɗok tǝtǝk! A put aku nɗǝǝn gwar nǝ!>>
Kaaɗe riin ɗebish nǝ yoon gwar nǝ ɓal-ɓal, ɓe nǝ le or shiɓal, ɓe nǝ put nɗǝǝn gwar nǝ.
Ne aapwoo gurum nǝ mo jir, har mo ɗoom tal pushak nǝ, <<A me nɗesǝ ye? A mee kám ɗepoo nɗesi! Wu satpwoo shi iiko, ɓe har riin ɗebish mo cìn mbii ɗe wu sat.>>
Abet ɓe pwoo nkaa Jesu nǝ put dǝm nɗǝǝn yil ɗe mo neer Galili ciirkaat jir.
Jesu Bar Nǝǝnkaam mPita
Kaaɗe mo pwat nɗǝǝn lu Naan nǝ, ɓe mo dǝm ntul Simon Pita kǝ Andru, ashak kǝ Jemis kǝ Joon.
Ɓe mo kat nǝǝnkaam Pita waa saam kǝ cilem. Abet ɓe mo sat nJesu.
Ɓe wur jì yaa sar waa, wu ɗyeep waa tong a tǝng, ɓe cilem nǝ kyes nwar, ɓe war cìn ɗak mbiise mmo.
Jesu Bar Gurum Mo Ɗes nKansǝǝn
Nkansǝǝn, kaaɗi puus nǝ ɗoom taa nlu, ɓe gurum mo jì kǝ nen ciinkoom mo ɗes, ɗe mo kǝ riin ɗebish mo pee Jesu ɗi.
Nen yilkaam nǝ mo jir, mo jì kuur mpolu nǝ.
Jesu bar nenciinkoom mo ɗes, kǝ shwal mo shini-shini, wu pwat kǝ riin ɗebish mo ɗes zak. Baa wu yit kǝ riin ɗebish nǝ mo leshap ɗe kas, mbǝɗe mo kǝ man wur.
Jesu Satpwoo Naan nGalili
Ɗaar nǝ, ɓe Jesu yool put mpar-mpar, ɓe wur dǝm a peeɗi baa mee gurum ɗi kas, mbe wur ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan).
Pita kǝ nen ɗe mo ashak kǝ wur, mo pwat dǝm mbe yap wur.
Kaaɗe mo kat wur, ɓe mo sat nwur nǝnee, <<Gurum mo jir mo nkaa yap gha.>>
Jesu sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wu yit kǝ mu dǝm njep yil ɗe mo akyeen sǝ, mbǝkǝ nghan dǝm nsatpwo Naan ɗi nyil mǝnǝ mo zak. Mbǝɗe wen jì a mbe satpwoo Naan nǝ.>>
Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe wu dǝm nɗǝǝn yil nGalili jir, wu satpwoo Naan ngurum mo nɗǝǝn lu Naan mo, kǝ wur pwat kǝ riin ɗebish mo zak.
Jesu Bar nGuloom
Mee nguloom jì kurum nfurum ntoom Jesu, ɓe wu ɗang pǝ Jesu nǝnee, <<Katɗang a rǝɓet, ɓe gha mak bar nghan kǝ wen ɗee ɗi a ɗeɓang.>>
Jesu naajeel gwar nǝ, ɓe wu zan sar fin, wu tung gwar nǝ, ɗang wur sat ngwar nǝ nǝnee, <<wen nlap ii, aa bar.
Abet, ɓe loom nǝ kyes, ɓe gwar nǝ zum.
Jesu satpwoo ngwar nǝ shiɓal. Ɓe wur ɓwet gwar nǝ abet-abet.

Ɓe wur sat ngwar nǝnee, <<A tap, taji a sat mee mbii mmee gurum kas. Ɗangɓe a dǝm a kam sak fwaa mpris, mbǝkǝ wur naa gha ɗi, kǝ a shin zuum ɗi zak, kaaɗi gyet Mosis sat nǝ, nen ɗe mo ke ten zum, ɓe mo shin mbiizuum, mbǝkǝ gurum mo man nnǝ moo ke ɗee a ɗebǝbar.>>

Ɗangɓe gwar nǝ wur put, ɓe wur yaa satpwoo nǝ gurum mo ɗes, ɓe pwoo nǝ kaatpee jir, har nǝ le kǝ baa Jesu mak baa ɗel nɗǝǝn yil nǝ agaak kas. Ɗangɓe wur tong a peeɗi baa mee gurum mo ɗe kas. Jir kǝsǝ, ɓe gurum mo pwat shipee-shipee, mo dǝm pee wur ɗi.
